title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - BacterialProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/BacterialProperty. A bacterial property is a property of water that is related to bacteria. Subclass of MicrobialProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the MicrobialProperty model and not repeated here. Named individuals of this class defined in the ontology (used elsewhere as controlled-vocabulary values, e.g. as enum items of Water.hasProperty): ClostridiumPerfringens, ColiformBacteria, ColonyCount22C (label 'Colony count at 22°C'), ColonyCount37C (label 'Colony count at 37°C'), Enterococci, EscherichiaColi (label 'E. coli'), PseudomonasAeruginosa.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BacterialProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
